notes.title: Ruff City Patch 1
notes.content:
[h3]Hello![/h3]

Thank you so much to all who have purchased and played the game. I gathered your feedback and implemented some of them with some bug fixes. Below is the changelog

- Added IFrames To Player
- Can now damage [spoiler]Gorilla boss[/spoiler]  during roller attack
- Fixed bug where special was not attacking enemies properly
- Add controls to Paws Menu
- Fixed some [spoiler]Corgi Boss[/spoiler] Issues
- Changed Player Jump Implementation
- Blocking now gains DoggyMeter
- Increased DoggyMeter for Attacking and Getting Hit
- Added Credits to MainMenu
- Added Audio Track to Intro Scroll
- Increased Boss HP for Multiplayer
- Fixed Screen Resolution issues
- Capped FPS to 60
- Enemy Dialogue now lasts longer on screen
- Some Dialogue Text Edits

My next update will be to add Steam Achievements in time for the March Steam Sale.

[h3]Thank you again!
Stay Awesome![/h3]
